ItemID: unavailable; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Vocal duets appeal to me given my interest in A Musical Affair and Lead With Your Heart.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have enjoyed Christmas music, but I am not seeking another holiday album right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: To Be Loved; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Polished, melodic vocals fit the mood I enjoy in Stages and Under One Sky.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Down To My Last Bad Habit; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This feels less connected to the orchestral and vocal music I currently want.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Duets II; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The duet format interests me, but I would try Partners first this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Very Best Of; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist or track list, I cannot tell whether this collection suits my taste.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Blown Away; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My past interest in 747 and Golden makes this plausible, but I want gentler vocal music today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: I Dreamed A Dream; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Expressive singing and musical-theater material strongly fit my enjoyment of Stages and A Musical Affair.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Cheek to Cheek; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Vocal standards sound appealing alongside my interest in melodic ensemble singing.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: A Pentatonix Christmas; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The vocal harmonies could appeal, but holiday music is not what I would choose this time.
